title: Tool Registry and Dispatch
learning_objectives: Register tools with a name, function and argument schema
Return structured success/error results instead of crashing
entry_point: class ToolRegistry: register(name, fn, schema, description=''), dispatch(call), describe()
hints: Check missing = sorted(schema − args), unexpected = sorted(args − schema), then types.
Wrap `fn(**args)` in `try/except Exception as e` and format `type(e).__name__`.

failure_feedback.advice: Catch exceptions from the tool and return them as an error dict.
Reject bools for int/float parameters; floats accept ints.
Check missing args before unexpected args, each in sorted order.
Return tools sorted by name with argument type names.
